response.justification: The candidate is an experienced generalist software engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and DLang/TypeScript expertise, but the resume shows almost no alignment with the role's mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the 5-10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development required. There is no SQL Server or Oracle experience listed (only MySQL/MongoDB and generic 'SQL'), and no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital is a fintech/investment-adjacent role but the work described is Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, not trading or fixed-income systems. Strong communication skills and engineering fundamentals are evident, but they cannot compensate for missing all three mandatory pillars.
strengths: Broad, deep engineering experience across backend, low-latency, and distributed systems
Proven communication ability via conference talks, workshops, and courses
Strong DevOps/CI-CD, testing, and craftsmanship practices (TDD, trunk-based development)
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ work, none on Windows in the last decade
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain exposure
